messages:
emily: Quick signal from nightly PTQ run on v2.1-reranker-int8: MRR down ~3.1% on short-query slice (<=10 tokens). NDCG@10 nearly unchanged.

sanjay: that smells like top1 flips. Did we add priming or any new prefix templates recently?

emily: yes 1 added a short candidate priming line to help intent. Tokenizer and vocab unchanged.

tara: typical PTQ margin compression + priming interaction. Can you run an ablation: (1) remove priming, (2) slice-aware calibration on primed inputs, (3) small post-quant bias scan?

emily: queued small CI jobs: jobA remove-priming, jobB slice-calib-5k-primed, jobC bias-scan-scalar.

eval-bot: jobA finished 1 removing priming restores MRR to within 0.2% of fp32.

sanjay: confirms priming+quant interaction. Prioritize slice-calib then bias-scan if residual delta. Also add pad-parity test (left vs right).

emily: running pad parity and microbatch-length12 kernel check too.

jun: for metrics, please capture top1 flips and top2/top1 margin distribution. Small margin compression often explains large MRR moves with small NDCG change.

emily: pulled 2k-sample diff: 82 top1 flips, mean top1-top2 margin dropped 0.58->0.25 (fp32->int8). Dumping a few examples to gist and will attach.

tara: plan: 1) integrate slice-aware calibration into PTQ pipeline for routes that use priming, 2) implement optional conditional post-quant bias per-slice, 3) add priming-PTQ checklist to onboarding. Rollback: disable priming for short-query route in shadow if needed.

sanjay: sound plan. @emily please assign JIRA tickets and tag infra for extra GPU for microbatch runs.

emily: will do and post logs. thanks all :thumbsup:
